english.note: Use this colloquial phrase when stressing that someone can manage or get the difficult thing under control.
Use this colloquial expression when saying that you can cope or get something done without help.

examples.english: Can you cope with all these jobs on your own?
examples.traditional: 咁多單嘢，你一個人搞得掂呀？
examples.jyutping: gam3 do1 daan1 je5 nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3

examples.english: I can manage this report by myself.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告我自己搞得掂。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6
